children: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq futures extended losses slightly on Thursday after producer prices data for August.
A Labor Department report showed the Producer Price Index rose 5.4% on an annual basis in August, compared with estimates of a 5.3% increase.
On a monthly basis, it rose 0.4% compared with an estimated 0.4% rise.
